title: XRP Ledger has fewer active accounts than last year, but bigger trades and more value
summary: Daily order-book traders fell about 40% from a year ago while volume rose 79%, as the value held on XRPL climbed above $4 billion.

title: Southeast Asia’s crypto funding rebounds to $680 million as investors focus on mature firms
summary: Blockchain investment in Southeast Asia in 2026 has been led by crypto financial services, though funding remains heavily concentrated  in Singapore and a handful of companies.

title: Robinhood isn't backing down after AMC CEO demands halt to stock tokens
summary: AMC boss Adam Aron called Robinhood’s stock tokens “synthetic equity” and threatened legal action. Vlad Tenev says the brokerage stands behind the product.

title: From warning to listing: UK’s largest retail investment platform opens access to crypto ETNs
summary: The U.K.'s largest retail investment platform, Hargreaves Lansdown, has reversed course following the FCA's decision to lift its retail ban on crypto ETPs in October.

title: U.S. Sheriff’s association shifts opposition stance to Clarity Act to 'neutral'
summary: The law enforcement association said it has pivoted its position regarding the Clarity Act to neutral, months after it warned against a law it said would shield crypto crime.
